purpose: Check whether GRI v2 preserves an externally reported directional contrast within a closely related genomic privacy setting.
claims_not_supported: This is not an a priori validation hypothesis.
This is not independent external validation of GRI v2.
Passing this test does not establish construct validity.
This test must not be used to tune the scoring function.

comparisons.rationale: The two cases represent related membership-inference conditions from the same study family with reported attack-power magnitudes of 0.20 and 0.35. Because both are registered as direct D1 risk fractions, the scoring system should preserve the reported ordering.
